reference_reply:
TL;DR: no, we don't support either one today (checked litellm main @ 4a8b475).

Search: our unified `/v1/search` (`litellm.search()`) has 20 providers (tavily, exa, brave, perplexity, firecrawl, etc.) and `deepseek` isn't one of them. Adding it is small: one `litellm/llms/deepseek/search/transformation.py` modeled on the tavily one (~200 lines), plus an enum entry and a cost-map entry. It maps cleanly onto our shape: `query`, `count` -> `max_results`, `title`/`url`/`snippet`/`date`.
Fetch: we have no unified fetch/scrape endpoint at all, so `POST /v1/tools/fetch` would mean a new endpoint, not just a new provider. There's no DeepSeek pass-through route either.
Want me to open a PR for DeepSeek search now and do fetch as a follow-up?
